# Safety Checklist: Shared Codex advisor tab

**Purpose**: Check that the spec fully defines how the shared Codex tab stays review-only, protects the user's files and conversation, and handles prompts it must not approve.
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of prompts the orchestrator may approve listed exactly, not only by example? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it defined which files the before-and-after check covers: tracked, untracked, ignored, files outside the project folder? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it defined what the orchestrator does when the monitor reports a prompt while no review is running (the user's own turn)? [Gap, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the content of the "close the tab to apply" line defined, including which values changed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "read-only command" defined so that a command with a side effect (a test that writes a cache, a lint with `--fix`) is clearly in or out? [Clarity, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "the user's normal sandbox and approval settings" defined for a folder that is not in the user's Codex config? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "exact screen text" bounded (how many lines, escape codes removed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do FR-006 (blocked tab goes to the background) and FR-009 (prompt during a review keeps waiting) agree on which blocked state each covers? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK009 Does FR-004 (never close the tab) agree with the time-out path in FR-012 and the start-up failure paths? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the review-only wording in FR-007 the same in the prompt and in the st-build skill? [Consistency]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is the case covered where the user changes a file in the checkout during a review (the check fails, user decides)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the case covered where two points run at the same time for the same tab? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the recovery defined after a BLOCKED change-check: how the user continues or re-runs the point? [Recovery, Spec §US2]

## Non-Functional

- [ ] CHK014 Is it stated that review prompts and project text now go into the user's own Codex history, and is that acceptable? [Privacy, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the time budget defined for a point that waits on the orchestrator's answer? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
